exact_statement: For every even k>=4 and m>=0, let n=k+m, delta=2^-n, G be the k-bit quadratic bent Boolean sign embedded with m dummy shared bits, H=G-2*1_zero on the actual n-bit cube, and let M select G,H by one fresh uniform physical bit. I(G)=k/2,I(H)=k/2+2n delta,I(M)=k/2+(n+1)delta. For K=17/8 the exact averaged child bank S_K=[K I(G)-H(G)+K I(H)-H(H)]/2 pays the selector excess E_K=H(M)-[H(G)+H(H)]/2-K delta with S_K-E_K>1/64. Thus the explicit complete squared-spectrum reference Q_M has CE=H(M)<(17/8)I(M). The non-flat entropy estimate is H(H)-k<=2^-k(k+2+1/ln2), and the proved shared-width tax is substituted at t=n,d*=delta. The price-two extension of the unpadded reserve is false: k=4,n>=22 gives H(M)-2I(M)>=delta[2n-42-4n*2^(4-n)]>0. For any independent arbitrary Boolean terminal q and supplied normalized positive-support finite-cost R_q, the fixed product reference for qM retains CE=c_q+H(M),KL=D(P_q||R_q) and I=I(q)+I(M). Inserting qM under r>=1 fresh point controls, p=2^-r,mu=E(qM), the calibrated complete activation reference has CE<=p c_q+(17/8)p I(M)+6rp(1-mu), physical I=p[I(q)+I(M)+r(1-mu)] and exact KL=p[D(P_q||R_q)-D_Ber(P_qM(empty)||R_qM(empty))]. Therefore c_q<=C I(q) conditionally yields CE<=max(C,6)I for this insertion. The reserve is spent only in M and controller influences are fresh. These are scoped non-flat reserve/payment and transport results, not a universal FEI proof or FEI counterexample.
hypotheses: Uniform finite Boolean physical cubes; k>=4 even,m>=0; flip the full n-bit zero point where the quadratic sign is +1
Selectors and activation controls are fresh, point controls test once; every old zero-neighbor edge is nonpivotal before the flip
Reference Q_M is the explicit structural spectrum formula; arbitrary terminal reference is normalized, positive on true support and finite cost
All costs bits; ideal CE and separate single-word integer rounding; all calibration savings explicit
Price-two obstruction is an unclaimed extension of the original unpadded theorem, not a refutation of A086 at its actual scope
Arbitrary-terminal influence bound is a conditional hypothesis; no terminal cost is silently paid by the M reserve
